mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM Manufacturing Index (proxy: INDPRO) falls below 45, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it signals an impending recession that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 45 but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, signaling a restrictive monetary policy, it will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, especially if accompanied by a flattening or inverted yield curve.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts, defined as a 20% YoY decline in the HOUST series, signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST YoY decline > 20% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is rising and payroll employment is falling simultaneously, it signals a rapidly deteriorating labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rising and PAYEMS falling simultaneously but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL), defined as a 3-month annualized increase exceeding 6%, signals a high inflation regime that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL 3-month annualized increase > 6% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) is in a sustained decline, defined as two consecutive quarters of negative QoQ growth, it signals a recession that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by rising unemployment.
failure_condition: 2 consecutive quarters of negative GDPC1 QoQ growth but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of instances.
